title: The adjacent completed input reduction is the canonical derived transition
statement: For a prime l, finite extension E/Q_l, scheme X, derived completed coefficient object K, and n≥0, the restriction of the compact-support quotient reduction from n+1 to n followed by its restriction compositor equals the canonical adjacent derived reduction transition.

lean.statement:
theorem sfDirectImageInputTransition_adjacent
    (K : DerivedCategory (scalarReductionSource l E X)) (n : ℕ) :
    (scalarReductionDerivedRestriction l E X (n + 1)).map
          (compactSupportReductionMap l E X (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n) K) ≫
        (compactSupportRestrictionComp l E X (n + 1) n (Nat.le_succ n)).hom.app
          ((scalarReductionDerivedExtension l E X n).obj K) =
      (sfDerivedReductionTransition l E X n).app K
